strategy_roster.name: Volume Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The documented volume deviation uses volume_ratio(20), with 2.0 as the long breakout threshold and 1.0 as mean reversion. The short side is omitted; 2% is the documented stop.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Hidden Markov Model
strategy_roster.notes: The HMM state filter is unavailable, so MACD(12,26,9) bullish and bearish crosses proxy Markov-confirmed trend changes. ATR stop logic has no documented multiplier and is not a percentage field.

strategy_roster.name: Daily Bollinger Band
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) is an explicit fallback because the docs give no period or deviation. A positive middle-band slope retains the long rule, the middle-band cross is the exit, and ATR sizing is not representable.

strategy_roster.name: RK's Framework Auto Color Gradient
strategy_roster.notes: The unavailable stochastic normalization is proxied by averaging z-score(14) Bollinger %B and RSI(14). Bollinger(20,2) and RSI(14) are explicit fallbacks because no defaults are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Liquidex
strategy_roster.notes: Keltner(10) is approximated by EMA(10) plus or minus 2 ATR(10); the multiplier is an explicit fallback because none is documented. A center-line cross is the exit proxy; point stop, disabled target, break-even, and trailing logic are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Exp XMA Range Bands
strategy_roster.entry_long: close <= ema(close,20) + 2 * atr(high,low,close,14) and close >= ema(close,20) - 2 * atr(high,low,close,14) and bars_since(close > ema(close,20) + 2 * atr(high,low,close,14)) < 3
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20), ATR(14), and 2 ATR are explicit fallbacks for the parameterless Keltner channel. The entry requires a recent upper break followed by re-entry inside; a lower break exits. Point stop and target values are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Day Opening MACD Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(58,195,183) above a positive one-bar MACD slope proxies bullish histogram direction, with the inverse as exit. Daily-open timing and trailing management are unsupported; all documented exits are price points.

strategy_roster.name: 5/8 EMA Cross Protect
strategy_roster.notes: The documented fast EMA(5) uses close and slow EMA(8) uses open; their bullish crossover enters and bearish crossover exits. The 40-pip target, disabled stop, and disabled trailing stop are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Open Close
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(open,1)>0 with ROC(close,1)<0 exactly proxies a current open above the prior open and close below the prior close. The exit requires both values to continue lower; portfolio-risk protection is not a fixed percentage stop.

strategy_roster.name: SimpleTrade Flip
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(open,3)>0 compares the current open with the open three bars earlier and selects the documented long flip; the inverse exits. Reopening every bar cannot be represented by a one-position long-only simulator, and the 120-point stop is not a percentage.
